title: How the financial figures reconcile
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
METHODOLOGY
36
How the financial figures reconcile
01
Paid milestones
Sum settled grant installments by payment
date; exclude unpaid rows and other ledger
types. The captured ledger contains 1,005
unique IDs.
02
Comparisons and shares
MoM = (current / prior - 1) × 100. Category
shares use USD paid in the closed month.
Education and Community stay separate; sum
before rounding.
03
Decision evidence
Use ZCG minutes and amendments, including
conditions on partial approvals. Requested
amounts cannot stand in for approved
budgets.
04
Activity evidence
Use official release records and author
reports. Community counts are self-reported,
without an independent activity audit.
05
Round reconciliation
The $8,036,992 large-request sum exceeds
the source subtotal by $810. All 37 entries
match FPF ready-for-vote labels; the report
uses their row sum.
06
Treasury calculation
Multiply recorded ZEC by the dated quote,
round each account to cents, then sum.
Preserve the original source valuation and
keep price effects separate from flows.

Separate DAO allocations
ZecHub approvals A172 (East Africa), A173
(multilingual wiki) and A175 (India, Sep-Dec)
are excluded from payment totals.
04
Prerelease snapshot
Vizor 0.0.55-rc.0, dated Sep 10, is a
prerelease. The wallet feature uses the stable
release.
05
Readiness checkpoint
September 30 in the NU7 poll is a readiness
checkpoint, not a confirmed mainnet
activation date.
06
Funding scope
ZECsy’s approval covers nine-month
milestones only. The approval register retains
the full request for reference.
